T: We are Venom. We are hungry.
D: A disgraced reporter bonds with an alien symbiote that has a big appetite.
P: Serve the mains when Eddie climbs into the lobster tank at the restaurant.
S: Frozen potato gems baked at 220C for 20 minutes until crunchy, with a chilli and garlic mayo.
the black goo of the symbiote
Chicken pieces fried crisp, tossed in a sticky soy and honey glaze, coated in black sesame seeds.
M: Eddie jumping into the restaurant's lobster tank
Lobster tails split, brushed with garlic and herb butter, grilled 6 minutes, with fries and lemon.
Eddie and Venom starving at all hours
Beef patties grilled with cheddar melted on, stacked with crisp bacon and pickles in toasted buns, a pile of fries cooked twice until crunchy.
W: Silky Hong Kong mango pudding with evaporated milk poured over. Dissolve 3 tsp gelatine in 100ml hot water.
K: Strong black tea sweetened with condensed milk, chilled and poured over ice with a splash of milk.

s.note: the black goo of the symbiote
s.how: Toss 600g chicken thigh pieces in cornflour and fry until crisp. Warm 3 tbsp soy sauce with 3 tbsp honey until bubbling and toss the chicken through. Roll in black sesame seeds until coated and dark. Serve on toothpicks.

Bake 1kg frozen potato gems at 220C for 20 minutes, turning once, until crunchy. Mix 150g mayonnaise with 2 tbsp sriracha and 1 crushed garlic clove. Serve the gems in a big bowl with the mayo for dunking.

m.note: Eddie jumping into the restaurant's lobster tank
m.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into fries and fry twice until crisp. Split 4 lobster tails, brush with butter mixed with crushed garlic and parsley, and grill for 6 minutes until just cooked. Serve with the fries and lemon wedges. Tater tots optional.

w.how: Dissolve 3 tsp gelatine in 100ml hot water. Blend 2 mangoes with 80g sugar and 150ml cream, stir in the gelatine and set in 4 glasses for 3 hours. Pour over a little evaporated milk to serve.

d.how: Steep 4 black tea bags in 500ml boiling water for 5 minutes, remove, stir in 4 tbsp sweetened condensed milk and chill. Pour over ice in 4 glasses and top each with a splash of cold milk.
